Package com.privatechain.access.rbac

Enum Class NodeRole

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NodeRole>
com.privatechain.access.rbac.NodeRole
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NodeRole>, Constable
public enum NodeRole extends Enum<NodeRole>
Enumeration of node roles in a private blockchain network.

Each role carries specific capabilities for block submission, transaction submission, validation, and reading from the chain. This enum is used by PermissionManager to enforce role-based access control (FR-AC-02, FR-AC-03).

Role hierarchy and capabilities

  • NODE_ADMIN: Full authority. Can submit blocks, transactions, validate, read, and manage the network (add/remove peers).
  • NODE_MINER: Can produce blocks and submit transactions, but cannot validate blocks produced by other nodes.
  • NODE_OBSERVER: Read-only access. Can query the chain and view events but cannot submit blocks or transactions.
Since:
1.0.0

  • Enum Constant Details

    • NODE_ADMIN

      public static final NodeRole NODE_ADMIN
      Administrator node with unrestricted permissions. Can submit blocks, submit transactions, validate blocks, and read all data.

    • NODE_MINER

      public static final NodeRole NODE_MINER
      Mining node with permission to produce and submit blocks, and submit transactions. Cannot validate or review blocks (assumes the network enforces strict consensus rules).

    • NODE_OBSERVER

      public static final NodeRole NODE_OBSERVER
      Observer node with read-only access to the chain. Cannot submit transactions or blocks but can query state and listen to events.
